newsitem.title: USA: Most Indiana corn good-excellent, soy mostly seeded.
newsitem.headline: Most Indiana corn good-excellent, soy mostly seeded.

text.p: The Indiana corn crop as of Sunday was rated 54 percent good to excellent, according to the Indiana Agricultural Statistics Service.
Thirty four percent of the corn crop was rated fair, nine percent poor and three percent very poor.
The soybean crop was 96 percent seeded as of Sunday and was rated eight percent excellent, 47 percent good, 34 percent fair, eight percent poor and three percent very poor.

Winter wheat harvest was beginning with three percent of the crop harvested as of Sunday. Winter wheat condition was rated one percent very poor, five percent poor, 29 percent fair, 52 percent good and 13 percent excellent.
Topsoil moisture was 48 percent surplus, 51 percent adequate and one percent short.
Pasture conditions were rated 14 percent excellent, 62 percent good, 19 percent fair, four percent poor and one percent very poor.
The first cutting of alfalfa was 58 percent complete.
